field.codeLong: That code is too long. Please check it.

auth.resendIn: You can send it again in {{seconds}} seconds
auth.codeSentIfAccount: If there's an account with this number or email, we've sent it a code. It works for 5 minutes.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Your stock, orders and deliveries in one place.
signIn.newHere: New here? Try Pro free for 14 days.

twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. If you don't have your phone, enter a recovery code.
twoStep.label: App code or recovery code

signUp.title: New account
signUp.subtitle: Try Pro free for 14 days.
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.codeTo: Where should we send the code?
signUp.unavailable: New accounts can't be created right now. Please try again a little later.
signUp.codeSent: We've sent a 6-digit code to {{to}}. If it doesn't arrive, there may already be an account with it: try signing in.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter your phone number or email and we'll send you a code.
forgot.done: Your password has been changed. Now sign in.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twoFactor.off: Signing in also needs a code from an app on your phone, so someone who knows your password still can't sign in.
twoFactor.passwordStep: Enter your password to confirm it's you.
twoFactor.scanStep: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, then enter the app's 6-digit code.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.secret: Can't scan? Type this key instead
twoFactor.codesWarning: Keep these somewhere safe now: they won't be shown again. If you lose your phone, each one signs you in once.
twoFactor.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please write the codes down.
twoFactor.newCodesStep: Your old recovery codes will stop working. Enter a code from the app to confirm.
twoFactor.offStep: To turn it off, enter your password and a code from the app, or a recovery code.
twoFactor.offDone: Two-step sign-in has been turned off.

business.title: Business
business.name: Business name
business.lost: You're no longer a member of "{{name}}".

welcome.title: Add your business
welcome.subtitle: To start, give the name of your shop or page. The rest can wait.
welcome.invited: If someone invited you to their business, open the link they sent you.

profile.title: Business details
profile.logoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB.

settings.title: Orders and stock
settings.SHIPHint: Confirming an order sets the stock aside; it goes down when handed to the courier.
settings.CONFIRMHint: Stock goes down as soon as an order is confirmed.
settings.lowStockHint: Used for products without a level of their own.
settings.prefixHint: English letters, digits and hyphens, up to 10. For example RK-
settings.footer: Text at the bottom of slips
settings.footerHint: Printed at the bottom of packing slips, such as thanks or a returns policy.

deletion.title: Delete business
deletion.description: All of the business's data goes after 7 days. You can bring it back during those 7 days.
deletion.confirm: Products, orders, customers and everything else go for good after 7 days. Your account stays. Enter your password to confirm.

staff.title: Team
staff.removeDescription: They lose access to this business at once, and their open invites are cancelled. You can invite them again later.
staff.transferDescription: They become the business's owner and you become a manager. Enter your password to confirm.
staff.rolesExplained: Staff work with orders and stock but don't see cost prices. Managers can also manage products, members and settings.
staff.leaveDescription: You won't be able to get back in unless you're invited again.

invite.title: Invite
invite.noLink: There's no invite in this link. Please open the link you were sent again.
invite.heading: Join "{{name}}"
invite.signedInAs: You're signed in as {{name}}. The invite was sent to {{sentTo}}.
invite.signInFirst: The invite was sent to {{sentTo}}. To join, sign in with that phone or email, or create an account.

products.lowStockNone: Nothing is running low right now.
products.name: Product name
products.costHint: Only owners and managers see this.
products.openingStockEach: Each variant starts with this many.
products.thresholdHint: Leave empty to use the business's level.

options.title: Options
options.explain: Such as Size: S, M, L and Colour: Red, Blue. Each combination becomes a variant. Up to 3 options.
options.explainEdit: Removing a value archives its variants; adding it back restores them with their SKU and price.
options.name: Option name
options.incomplete: Give each option a name and at least one value.
options.tooMany: A product can have up to 100 variants.

images.title: Images
images.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB, at least 100 × 100 pixels. Open an image to arrange it. Location data is removed from photos.

hint.RECEIVE: Enter how many arrived. They're added to the stock.
hint.DAMAGE: Enter how many went. They're taken off the stock.
hint.COUNT: Enter the total you counted. The stock becomes that number.

stock.nothing: Enter a number in at least one box.

categories.title: Categories and tags
categories.name: Name
categories.deleteDescription: If it has products or subcategories, move those first.
categories.deleteTagDescription: The products stay; only this tag comes off them.
